consent.HEADING: Before we begin
consent.SUB: Under India's DPDP Act 2023, we need your informed consent before processing any of your documents. Please read what we do — and what we don't.
consent.DPDP_BADGE: ⚖️  Compliant with Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
consent.SECT_WHAT_ITEM1: Documents pushed by your employer (salary slips, Form 16, letters)
consent.SECT_WHAT_ITEM3: Career events inferred from your documents
consent.SECT_HOW_ITEM1: Documents are processed in-memory by an LLM — raw figures are never stored
consent.SECT_HOW_ITEM2: Only insights and growth indices are stored, not salary numbers or PAN
consent.SECT_HOW_ITEM3: Your PAN is encrypted immediately at ingestion — never stored in plaintext
consent.SECT_HOW_ITEM4: Password-protected documents are decrypted only in a time-limited session you control
consent.SECT_WHO_ITEM2: Third parties only via time-limited share links you create
consent.SECT_WHO_ITEM3: PRANA staff cannot access your document content — only encrypted metadata
consent.SECT_RIGHTS_ITEM1: Right to access — download all your data at any time
consent.SECT_RIGHTS_ITEM2: Right to correction — dispute any wrongly attributed document
consent.SECT_RIGHTS_ITEM3: Right to erasure — request full account and data deletion
consent.SECT_RIGHTS_ITEM4: Right to withdraw consent — you may withdraw at any time
consent.CHECKBOX_LABEL: I have read and understood how PRANA processes my data. I consent to the processing described above.
consent.FOOTER_NOTE: You can withdraw consent or request data deletion at any time from Settings → My Data Rights.
